mapper.select: SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, platform_commission_rate AS platformCommissionRate, payment_fee_rate AS paymentFeeRate, merchant_delivery_fee_amount AS merchantDeliveryFeeAmount, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, enabled FROM external_store_fee_policies WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_store_id = #{externalStoreId} ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, platform_commission_rate AS platformCommissionRate, payment_fee_rate AS paymentFeeRate, merchant_delivery_fee_amount AS merchantDeliveryFeeAmount, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, enabled FROM external_store_fee_policies WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_store_id = #{externalStoreId} AND enabled = 1 AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_store_fee_policies ( provider_type, external_store_id, platform_commission_rate, payment_fee_rate, merchant_delivery_fee_amount, effective_from, effective_to, enabled ) VALUES ( #{platformType}, #{externalStoreId}, #{request.platformCommissionRate}, #{request.paymentFeeRate}, #{request.merchantDeliveryFeeAmount}, #{request.effectiveFrom}, #{request.effectiveTo}, #{request.enabled} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform_commission_rate = VALUES(platform_commission_rate), payment_fee_rate = VALUES(payment_fee_rate), merchant_delivery_fee_amount = VALUES(merchant_delivery_fee_amount), effective_to = VALUES(effective_to), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
